question: Is a permanent with living metal an artifact creature during my opponents' turns?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it is an artifact creature only as long as it is your turn.
expected.answer: "Living metal" means "As long as it's your turn, this permanent is an artifact creature in addition to its other types."
